question: How many annual leave days are full-time employees entitled to per calendar year?

expected_answer: Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused annual vacation days into the subsequent year. Any additional unused leave lapses on December 31.

expected_answer: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave annually. A medical certificate is mandatory for sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

expected_answer: Standard enterprise working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday.

question: What are the mandatory core working hours during which team members must be available?
